prompt_text:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, photorealistic short-drama shot in warm afternoon daylight with natural skin texture, continuing exactly from <Picture 1>: a close medium shot of the young East Asian woman with long straight dark hair and bangs and a plain white T-shirt, sitting on a wooden park bench, smiling down at the black smartphone in both hands, with a sunlit tree-lined path softly out of focus behind her. Her face, hair, clothing, the phone and the framing stay exactly as in <Picture 1>, and the camera holds a static shot. For a moment she keeps reading with the same smile. A friendly young voice from far away off-screen to the left (S1) calls out: <d>[English] Lin!</d> She hears it: her smile pauses, her eyes lift from the phone, and she raises her head and turns it slightly to the left, her eyes searching far along the path. Her eyebrows rise in surprise, her lips part a little, and then her eyes find someone in the distance and her face lights up with recognition. She lowers the phone toward her lap. She blinks once. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical and aim at the same far point to the left; her facial proportions stay unchanged as her head turns, and she never looks into the lens. She does not speak. There is no text and no subtitle anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Birdsong in the trees, leaves rustling in a light breeze, and the soft rustle of her sleeve as she lowers the phone.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
